subject: Provisional billing remediation & VAT evidence for ClearLane
snippet: Customer provides VAT cert and asks for a provisional remediation refund while finance completes audit. Internal plan to issue temporary refund and follow with formal credit note.
messages:
From: Alec Turner <alec.turner@clearlane.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.inference
Cc: Helena Bauer <hbauer@clearlane.eu>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Billing discrepancy: Nov usage spike + VAT evidence

Hi Diego,

We're seeing a large spike on invoice CL-202611 (attached) that doesn't match our usage reports. Our accounting reviewed the line items and it looks like the ingestion connector processed duplicate events for three days (2026-11-03 to 2026-11-05). Can you confirm whether Redwood can provisionally remediate this while you perform a bill audit?

Two asks from our side:
- A provisional refund (or ledger hold) for the disputed amount so our month-end cash position isn't affected.
- We will provide our VAT certificate and bank details for a wire if needed — I can drop those by end of day.

We're happy to cooperate on logs/IDs to speed verification. Helena (cc'd) will handle tax evidence.

Thanks,
Alec Turner
Finance Manager | ClearLane Logistics
[attachment: invoice_CL-202611.pdf]
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.inference
To: Alec Turner <alec.turner@clearlane.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.inference>, Na omi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing discrepancy: Nov usage spike + VAT evidence

Hi Alec — thanks for flagging and for sharing the invoice.

We can absolutely provision a temporary remediation while our billing ops team completes a full audit. Proposed immediate steps:

1) Provisional hold/refund: Redwood can issue a provisional ledger credit equal to the disputed line amount (we estimate EUR 14,720 based on your attachment) within 3 business days. This will appear as a negative line on the November statement and will not require immediate contract amendment.
2) Evidence & bank details: please send the VAT certificate and banking instructions for refund/wire. Because you're EU-registered, we need the VAT certificate on file to avoid reverse-charge complications.
3) Audit window: our billing ops (cc Logan) will run a reconciliation against request IDs and duplicated connector traces. We expect a final determination in 7–10 business days. If confirmed, we'll issue a formal credit note and reissue the invoice; if not confirmed, we'll reverse the provisional credit and provide a detailed reconciliation.

Attachments we'll provide from our side: provisional_refund_rationale.xlsx and a DocuSign link for the amended invoice should we finalize the credit.

If that timeline works, I'll create a short mutual action plan and loop Legal if procurement/contract changes are needed.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Helena Bauer <hbauer@clearlane.eu>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.inference, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
Cc: Alec Turner <alec.turner@clearlane.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 07:28:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Billing discrepancy: Nov usage spike + VAT evidence

On Thu, 25 Nov 2026 at 11:05 AM diego_fernandez@redwood.inference wrote:
> Hi Alec — thanks for flagging and for sharing the invoice.
> 
> We can absolutely provision a temporary remediation while our billing ops team completes a full audit. Proposed immediate steps:

Thanks Diego — attaching the requested VAT certificate and bank details now.

Files attached: clearlane_vat_certificate.pdf, bank_instructions_CL.pdf.

A few clarifications from our side:
- The disputed amount (EUR 14,720) is our internal calc as well; we used raw ingestion counts and removed known retries.
- Please make the provisional ledger credit visible on our portal so our treasury team recognizes it on the November close. A short note in the portal and the memo field on the credit would be great.
- If Redwood needs a remittance form filled for the wire, let us know and we'll complete it.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Helena
Helena Bauer
Head of Tax | ClearLane Logistics
[attachment: clearlane_vat_certificate.pdf]
[attachment: bank_instructions_CL.pdf]
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.inference
To: Alec Turner <alec.turner@clearlane.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Billing discrepancy: Nov usage spike + VAT evidence

Alec / Helena — thanks for the quick response and for sending the VAT certificate.

Update and next steps (confirmed):

- Provisional ledger credit: we've applied a provisional credit of EUR 14,720 to your account today. It will appear in the Redwood Console under Billing > Credits and as a negative line on the November statement. Reference: CR-CL-202611-PROV (visible in the portal).
- Wire hold: since you provided bank instructions, Finance will queue a wire if you prefer an immediate payout instead of a credit. Please confirm preference in reply.
- Formal audit: Logan's team will complete the line-item reconciliation by 2026-12-10. If confirmed duplicate processing is validated, we'll issue a formal credit note and reissue the invoice; otherwise we'll reverse the provisional credit and share the reconciliation.
- Documentation: attached is our provisional_refund_rationale.xlsx and a DocuSign link to sign an amended invoice if you'd like the formal credit note sooner: https://www.docusign.com/CL-amended-invoice-202611.

Logan — please run the duplication check on request IDs 3b2f... and 7f9c... (referenced in Alec's usage CSV). Monica, looping you for exceptions approval if needed.

Alec/Helena — confirm whether you want the provisional amount wired (we'll need the bank remittance form completed) or left as a portal credit. Once you confirm, we'll proceed with the preferred path and keep the audit transparent.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
Diego.Fernandez@redwood.inference
[attachment: provisional_refund_rationale.xlsx]
